definitions.explanation: A device that uses electromagnetic fields to propel charged particles to high speeds and energies. Used in physics research, medical treatment, and industrial applications.

examples.japanese: {加速器|かそくき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{粒子|りゅうし}→粒子：14970_ryuushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}させる→衝突する：26785_shoutotsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To collide particles using an accelerator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{加速器|かそくき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The construction of a new accelerator is being planned.

examples.japanese: {医療用|いりょうよう}{加速器|かそくき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、がん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{放射線|ほうしゃせん}→放射線：14998_houshasen⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Medical accelerators are also used in radiation therapy for cancer treatment.

notes:
{加速器|かそくき} is a technical term for a machine that accelerates charged particles to high speeds. It is most commonly encountered in physics and medical contexts.

FULL FORM:
The full term is ⟦{粒子|りゅうし}→粒子：14970_ryuushi⟧{加速器|かそくき} (particle accelerator), but {加速器|かそくき} alone is commonly used.

TYPES:
- ⟦{線形|せんけい}→線形：28866_senkei⟧{加速器|かそくき}: linear accelerator (linac)
- ⟦{円形|えんけい}→円形：11674_enkei⟧{加速器|かそくき}: circular accelerator
- {医療用|いりょうよう}{加速器|かそくき}: medical accelerator (used in radiation therapy)

FORMS:
⟦{加速|かそく}→加速：00198_kasoku⟧ (acceleration) + {器|き} (device/instrument). The suffix {器|き} is productive for naming instruments and devices.

JAPAN CONTEXT:
Japan has major accelerator facilities, including KEK (⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧{加速器|かそくき}⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦{機構|きこう}→機構：02784_kikou⟧) in Tsukuba.
